record.question: By selling 45 lemons for Rs.40, a man loses 20%. How many should he sell for Rs.24 to gain 20% in the transaction?
record.explanation: 45 lemons sold for Rs40 at 20% loss means CP=Rs50. At 20% gain, Rs24 buys lemons with CP Rs20; CP per lemon=50/45, so count=18. Independently reviewed solution; unofficial, not an examiner key.
